info.title: MorrowList API
info.description: REST interface to the canonical MorrowList task model. Every capability in the product is reachable here, so the web UI, the CLI, and third-party clients are peers.

post.description: `blocks` reads source (this task) → target; `related_to` is symmetric and stored once. Neither task's version changes. A blocks edge that would close a loop is rejected with TASK_RELATION_CYCLE; an edge that already exists is a no-op.

post.description: Neighbour IDs describe the intended position; the server computes the authoritative rank. Entering an in-progress column past the workspace limit adds a warning; the move still succeeds.

post.description: Returns the task to its last active status. Landing in an in-progress column past the workspace limit adds a warning; the reopen still succeeds.

parameters.name: workspaceId

200.description: The reopened task and any limit warnings

post.summary: Skip the current occurrence of a repeating task
post.description: The task itself moves on to its next occurrence; nothing is created. A task without a recurrence rule, a completed one, or the last occurrence of a bounded series is rejected with VALIDATION_FAILED.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Target workspace. Optional when the caller can reach exactly one workspace.

200.description: The task on its next occurrence

post.summary: Make a task a subtask of another
post.description: The parent must be a live task in the same workspace. A cycle is rejected with TASK_RELATION_CYCLE and a fourth nesting level with TASK_NESTING_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Target workspace. Optional when the caller can reach exactly one workspace.

post.summary: Add a task to My Day
post.description: The date defaults to the workspace's current date. Adding a task to a day it is already planned for changes nothing. The task itself is untouched: no version bump, no due date or status change.

parameters.description: Target workspace. Optional when the caller can reach exactly one workspace.

get.description: The de-duplicated union of overdue, due-today, and My Day tasks in the workspace timezone, each task once under its highest-precedence section with badges for every reason, plus yesterday's unfinished manual selections for review.
